summary: Climax Entertainment's isometric Genesis action-adventure, reissued through Virtual Console, Steam/Sega Classics, Genesis Mini, and Nintendo Classics.

entries.title: Landstalker: The Treasures of King Nole

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Switch Online is the simple current official route; owned-dump emulation is the archival route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with modern emulator conveniences.

primary.why: The Switch Online Genesis release is the current official route and includes save/rewind convenience; older Virtual Console, Steam, and mini-console routes do not add exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the SEGA Genesis app through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack. For PC capture, use an owned Sega Classics copy or Genesis Plus GX with an owned dump.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern versions emulate the Genesis release rather than remaster it.
